label: When does an infinite regress weaken the case for this foundation’s possible absence?
summary: See docs/notes/contingency-receptivity-c2.md#what-does-possible-absence-have-in-common-with-an-infinite-regress. Copying can explain each transmission while leaving the choice of content open. A third lossy relay under an independently known bound rules out all distant supply of the measured unit. Lossless transfer leaves the amount open, while identified distributed inputs determine the output of an endless lossy chain. A giver cannot produce the actuality it presupposes for its own action, but another giver can supply it. A memberwise infinitist can explain each receipt on those terms. No collective prohibition or quantitative bound for existential giving is established. An endless series of referrals that presuppose the next omission's warrant supports no initial omission on its own. Infinitary support can succeed with information-rich conditional constraints. A determining explanation of n's actual existence cannot use solely reasons also obtaining without n. A contingent distinguishing reason would need independent content and explanatory priority compatible with underivedness. A nonnecessitating account or a primitive stopping point can reject the determining requirement. The no-ground stipulation is about P at actuality. High confidence in the specific explanatory failures and moderate confidence in suspension about bare P. No new theorem or formal premise change.
blocker: No independently grounded restriction identifies n as the only possible provider of received existence across all inhabited orders, and a concrete-empty alternative contains no supply chain. Underivedness rules out producing n by a lottery or agent, but does not imply that all explanations must determine their outcomes. The available rearrangements and references do not certify an independently admissible alternative incompatible with n. A new test would identify a substantive constraint on all remaining givers or an independently motivated rule that licenses a de re omission while remaining evidence for a primitive P rather than its full ground at actuality.
